AxisLine.description: An explicit line in model coordinates.

direction.description: Direction (ratio components); non-zero, normalised by the engine.

AxisObject.description: The object forms of an AxisRef; each may carry `flip`.

chain_added.description: Keys added by tangent-chain expansion (not part of the reference).

edges.description: Keys of the blended edges (the reference's members, then `chain_added`).

faces_created.description: Keys of the blend and corner faces created.

shells.description: Closed shells (2 for a body with an internal void).

anyOf.description: An expression of type Bool, e.g. `"!with_lid"`.

BoolScalar.description:
A boolean field that accepts expressions (SPEC-v1 §2.2, [W0-3]): a JSON boolean, or an
expression string of type Bool.

Candidate.description: A candidate for an unresolved member.

query.description: A synthesised query that selects exactly this candidate (SHOULD).

CandidateReason.description: Why a candidate is offered (§5.7 step 4).

oneOf.description: A piece of a split target.

Capture.description:
Snapshot of a reference's resolution (§5.6): one entry per member of the resolved set, in
canonical order. Canonical JSON, part of the feature's cache key, never shown in CadScript.

faces.description: Edge members: the keys of the two adjacent faces (naming recommendation 5), sorted.

Cardinality.description: Declared cardinality (§5.5): `one`, `some`, `any`, or an exact count `n ≥ 1`.

Carrier.description:
The exact carrier of a captured entity; axis directions are sign-canonical (§3.2), plane
normals outward. Angles in degrees ([W0-7]).

CylinderAxis.description: `{ "cylinder": Ref }` (face, `one`): the axis of a cylindrical or conical face.

DimensionReport.description: A dimension's evaluated and measured values.

measured.description: Measured at the solution, mm or degrees.

value.description: The evaluated `value` (driving dimensions only), mm or degrees.

Dir.description:
A direction (§3.2): a named direction, a vector (ratio components), or an AxisRef object
(its direction).

DirName.description:
Named directions (§3.2): signed `+X` … `-Z`, and unsigned `X`, `Y`, `Z` (parallel tests
ignore the sign; where a sign is needed they mean `+`).

EdgeAxis.description: `{ "edge": Ref }` (edge, `one`): a line edge's line or a circular edge's axis, sign-canonical.

End.description: `start` / `end` of a sweep or of a curve.

EntityKind.description: The kind of topological entity a reference designates.

bodies.description: Body features: the bodies created or modified, in canonical order (§6.0.5).

datum.description: Datum features: the evaluated frame or axis.

refs.description: Features with Ref fields: one entry per Ref-valued field, in field order (§5.8).

regions.description: Sketches: the regions found, in canonical region order (v0 §4.1).

removed.description: Body features: the origins of consumed bodies.

Fingerprint.description: Fingerprint fields of a captured member (§5.6). Values are exact (not tessellated).

local.description: The centroid normalised to the owning body's bounding box.

neighbors.description: Adjacent entities on the same carrier (the split signature).

FingerprintType.description: The canonical type recorded in a fingerprint.

oneOf.description: A face or edge of another type.

GeomTypeName.description: Canonical surface and curve types a `type` predicate can test (v0 §5).

HolePart.description: The faces a hole creates at one position (§5.2 rule 3).

HoleReport.description: One hole instance (§6.5), in position order.

depth.description: Depth to the shoulder, or `null` for a through hole.

HoleSize.description: Standard metric sizes of the `HOLE_SIZES` table (§6.5).

IdRename.description:
One id or name that migration rewrote because it does not match the v1 id grammar
([W0-12]). `from` is the original string: untrusted data, never to be spliced into prompts.

path.description: JSON pointer of the rewritten field in the v1 document.

LiteralCurve.description:
A curve with literal geometry: the members of an expanded compound curve (§4.1) and the
`solved` geometry of a sketch report (§4.4).

MigrationReport.description: What `migrate_v0_to_v1` changed beyond the schema string and sketch references.

renames.description: Rewritten ids and names, in document order.

Origin.description:
A body's identity (§5.2 rule 4): the feature that created it and the byte-wise smallest
curve id of its region's outer loop at creation; pattern copies add their instance.

ParamOut.description: An evaluated parameter value (`-0` is reported as `0`).

ParamReport.description: A parameter's evaluated value or error.

scope.description: `"doc"` for document parameters, else the part's name.

PartReport.description: The final state of one part.

instances.description: Non-seed instances the layout defines, minus `skip`.

Predicate.description: One predicate of a `filter` (§5.3); all angle tests use `QUERY_ANGLE_TOLERANCE`.

oneOf.description: F, E: the canonical type is `t`.
F: planar, outward normal equal to the **signed** direction.

E: a line parallel to the direction (either sign). F: a plane whose normal is
perpendicular to it, or a cylinder/cone whose axis is parallel to it.

E: a line perpendicular to it, or a circle whose normal is parallel to it. F: a plane
whose normal is parallel to it (either sign).
E: material angle < 180° − tol. Must be `true`.
E: material angle > 180° + tol. Must be `true`.
E: material angle within tol of 180°. Must be `true`.
F (cylinder, sphere; torus: minor radius), E (circle).

Probe.description: A probe (§7.6): locates an entity without persisting it.

Query.description: The query AST (§5.3). Kinds: **F** faces, **E** edges, **V** vertices, **B** bodies.

oneOf.description:
B, named: bodies whose origin feature is `feature` (with `member`: whose origin region's
outer loop contains `member`), including every piece of a split.
B, broad: every body in scope.
F, named: an extrude's cap faces.
F, named: a revolve's end-cap faces.
F, broad: every side face of the feature.
E, named: the junction edges swept from the sketch vertex at that curve end.

E, named if `a` and `b` are both named: edges with one adjacent face in `a` and the
other in `b`.
F, named: a face a hole created at position `at`.
F, broad: every face whose key has that feature id (and role label).
F, broad: every face of that pattern instance.
The tag's kind; the tag's query re-evaluated in the current scope (§6.12).
B → faces of the bodies; E → the two adjacent faces; V → incident faces.
B → all edges; F → boundary edges; V → incident edges.
F, E, V → the bodies containing them.
Members whose centroid projected on `dir` is within `LINEAR_TOLERANCE·s` of the max (min).
Members of maximal size (area, length or volume).

Ref.description: A reference (§5.1): a typed query plus a declared cardinality, with an optional capture.

capture.description:
Snapshot of what the reference resolved to when it was last accepted (§5.6). Written
only by the command layer.

card.description:
Declared cardinality (§5.5). Omitted means the field's default (canonical JSON omits
a `card` equal to the field's default).

kind.description: Must equal the static kind of `q` and be accepted by the field (`REF_KIND_MISMATCH`).

q.description: The query: the intent of the reference.

RefMember.description: One member of a resolved reference.

name.description: Display name (feature ids replaced by names; `#k` display indices allowed here only).

RefReport.description: The report entry of one Ref-valued field (§5.8).

added.description: Broad members added since the capture (`REF_SET_CHANGED`), keys.

field.description: JSON pointer of the field relative to the feature, e.g. `/edges`, `/on/face`.

members.description: The resolved set, in canonical order.

proposal.description:
For `REF_REPAIRED` / `REF_SET_CHANGED`: the rewritten reference (query and fresh
capture) that `acceptRefProposal` applies.

removed.description: Broad members removed since the capture, keys.

oneOf.description: Used, with warnings or infos only.
The feature fails with the reference's code.

loops.description: Number of boundary loops (1 outer + holes).

outer_curves.description: Sorted ids of the curves forming the outer loop (the region's stable name).

RenameKind.description: What kind of id or name was rewritten.

ReportError.description:
A machine-readable error (§7.4): a stable code, a message for people, and structured
`details` whose keys are listed per code in the catalogue (`ERROR_CODES` in
`ir-v1.constants.json`). Details never contain arena ids.

anyOf.description: A literal in the field's unit.

Scalar.description:
A numeric field value (SPEC-v1 §2.2 [D-7]): a JSON **number** is a literal in the field's
unit (mm or degrees); a JSON **string** is an expression (§2.3) in canonical form (§2.4).

oneOf.description: Probably unintended but well-defined (the agent's L1 check explains it).

closed_void.description: A closed shell (no open face) made an internal void.

SketchReport.description: The sketch block (§4.4): what the regions were built from, and the solver's verdict.

dof.description: Constrained mode only: remaining degrees of freedom.

solved.description:
The literal geometry the regions were built from: compound curves expanded into their
members, expressions evaluated, constrained sketches solved (arcs mapped back through
the `ccw` rule). The oracle replays this for constrained sketches (§8.1).

depth.description: Thread depth, or `null` for the full (through) depth.

Unresolved.description: A named member that did not resolve, with up to `MAX_CANDIDATES` candidates, best first.

UnresolvedReason.description: Why a named member did not resolve (§5.8).

Via.description: Whether a member came from a named source or a broad one (§5.3).

document.description: Document name (`meta.name`, or the file stem).

error.description:
Set when the document was rejected (CLI exit 2): the first rejection, with every
rejection in `details.errors` (`[{ code, path, message, details }]`).

features.description: One entry per non-suppressed feature, in timeline order over all parts.

migration.description:
Present when the input was an `aicad.ir/0` document whose migration rewrote ids or
names ([W0-12]): region `outer_curves`, feature names and ids in this report use the new
values; `renames[].from` is untrusted data.

params.description: Every parameter (document ones first, then per part, in declaration order).

parts.description: The final bodies of each part (§6.0.5), in part order.

status.description: `ok` iff every parameter and every feature is ok (warnings never change it).
